title: Noosa Triathlon

points: Australia's largest, oldest and highest profile triathlon. The swim is usually at Main Beach and the bike transition is at Lions Park.
It was meant to be a marathon, but it was too hard to find 42 km of good sealed road, so it became a triathlon instead.

The first one, in 1983, had 180 people. Now it's the biggest Olympic distance triathlon in the world and the biggest multisport festival in the Southern Hemisphere: five days, over 13,000 competitors from around the world and more than 30,000 spectators.

sources: Moved from Local facts for a chat (EO-TR-10, then EO-TR-14 Being a tour guide), 12/11/2026.
